user.title: Gemini Live
user.description: Enter your Google AI API key to connect to the Gemini Live API.

data_description.name: Name of this integration entry.
data_description.model: gemini-3.8-live is the recommended default. Extended Thinking reasons in the background; 3.1 Flash Live and 2.5 are legacy.
data_description.voice: Prebuilt Gemini voice used for spoken responses.
data_description.instructions: System prompt that defines how the assistant behaves. Home Assistant context is added automatically.
data_description.thinking_level: How much the model reasons before answering. Only used by 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (low/medium/high) and 3.1 Flash Live; ignored by gemini-3.8-live.
data_description.enable_google_search: Let Gemini search the web with Google for current information (weather, news, facts).
data_description.enable_affective_dialog: Gemini adapts tone and speaking style to the emotion in your voice. Not available on 3.1 Flash Live.
data_description.enable_proactive_audio: Gemini decides itself whether to respond and ignores speech not directed at it (e.g. TV, background conversations). Not available on 3.1 Flash Live.

mcp_menu.title: MCP Servers

mcp_add_sse.title: Add SSE MCP Server
mcp_add_sse.description: Add an MCP server reachable over HTTP (Streamable HTTP/SSE).

data_description.name: Unique name; used as prefix for the tool names (server__tool).
data_description.url: JSON-RPC endpoint of the MCP server (Streamable HTTP/SSE), e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123/api/mcp
data_description.token: Optional. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (e.g. a Home Assistant long-lived access token).

mcp_add_stdio.title: Add Stdio MCP Server
mcp_add_stdio.description: Add an MCP server that Home Assistant starts as a subprocess.

data_description.name: Unique name; used as prefix for the tool names (server__tool).
data_description.command: Executable started by Home Assistant, e.g. npx or uvx. Must exist inside the Home Assistant container.

error.invalid_url: Invalid URL. It must start with http:// or https://
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Gemini API
